If the population of the north-west district in 2017 is 52000, then what population of the north-east district is below poverty line in that year?
solution:

Population of north-west district in 2017 = 52,000

**Concept Used:**

Basic Percentage Calculation

**Calculation:**

⇒ Percentage population in north-west district in 2017 = 10%

⇒ Population of north-west district in 2017 = 52000

⇒ So, 1% of population comprises of = (52000)/(10)=5200 people

⇒ Then, Percentage of population of north-east district = 21%

⇒ Population of north-east district = 5200times 21=109200

⇒ Percentage of population in north-east district below poverty line = 42%

⇒ Population in north-east district who are below poverty line = 42% of 109200

⇒ Population in north-east district who are below poverty line = (42)/(100)times 109200=42times 1092=45864

**Therefore, the population of north-east district which is below the poverty line is 45864**
